cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Take a brush for the picnic crumbs; we'll use the route it gives us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. Can I put the sandwiches down and try the front door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep them with you. This route saves us carrying the picnic blanket downstairs. Take it from that shelf.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now we're at the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm. Are we eating here?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We are. Put them beside the wine to cool. This door has found us a picnic with a roof and a wine list. You choose the bottle; I'll choose when we leave.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 denies B2 alternate route by declaring the attic useful; A5 takes B4 eating question as A decision and allocates bottle choice while retaining departure control.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 attic causes A3 blanket advantage; B4 cellar and warm food cause A5 cooling and sheltered picnic. The door movement is accepted fantasy.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to put down food and try a conventional exit; B4 offers eating where they are, an actual solution A adopts.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4 cellar the picnic venue, increasing commitment to the malfunction rather than appending another arbitrary destination.
